sentences.en: All of a sudden, the door shut with a bang.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，门砰的一声关上了。

sentences.en: The neighbours have been banging about next door all morning.
sentences.zh: 邻居们一整个早上都在隔壁乒乒乓乓地乱响。

sentences.en: Kokkinakis banged your girlfriend. Sorry to tell you that, mate.
sentences.zh: Kokkinakis和你的女朋友发生过性关系。抱歉告诉你这件事，兄弟。

senses.zh: (突然)巨响，枪声，猛击，重击，刘海
